# App shortcut artwork

All artwork is bundled locally, so the shortcut bar does not request remote images.

- `uber.svg`: Uber wordmark from Simple Icons, https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/icons/uber.svg (retrieved 2026-10-28). The paths are unchanged; the SVG canvas trims empty vertical space and uses the approved white-on-black treatment. Primary brand reference: https://developer.uber.com/docs/riders/guides/design-guidelines.
- `spotify.svg`: Spotify brand icon from Simple Icons, https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/icons/spotify.svg (retrieved 2026-10-28). Unchanged monochrome geometry, shown on a white plate. Primary brand reference: https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/design.
- Both Simple Icons files are distributed under CC0 1.0; see `SIMPLE-ICONS-LICENSE.md`. Brand trademarks remain with their respective owners.
- `13cabs.svg`: genuine provider artwork; see `13cabs-source.md` for the exact source revision.
- Other taxi providers use the app's neutral taxi symbol until genuine provider files can be obtained. See `taxi-assets-note.md` for the retrieval limits and official reference pages.
- Phone uses a neutral handset drawn in the app's existing SVG icon style.
